以授权账号的个人身份发动态。自助接入、无需合作伙伴审批，适合投研观点触达专业受众: Post updates as the authorized account's personal profile. Self-service setup with no partner approval needed — good for reaching a professional audience with research commentary.
只有申请过 Marketing Developer Platform 的应用才会: Only present for apps approved for the Marketing Developer Platform; not having it is normal
只能删授权账号自己发的: Can only delete posts made by the authorized account itself

形如 urn:li:share:7xxxxxx，删除要用它: Looks like urn:li:share:7xxxxxx; needed for deletion

查一次授权账号。ok=false 多半是令牌到期了（LinkedIn 的令牌 6: Checks the authorized account once. ok=false usually means the token expired (LinkedIn tokens last 60 days)
点「授权」后由平台写入，勿手填。**LinkedIn 的令牌 60 天到期**，: Written by the platform after you click "Authorize" — don't fill it in by hand. **LinkedIn tokens expire after 60 days**, and most self-service apps don't get a refresh token — just click "Authorize" again when it expires
纯文本 + 换行（**不认 Markdown 也不认 HTML**）；上限 30: Plain text with line breaks (**no Markdown or HTML support**); 3000-character limit. LinkedIn automatically detects links in the text and generates preview cards, no need to build them yourself
